item.title: Area Sales Manager, New South Wales
item.description:
KOMPAN is the global leader in outdoor play and fitness solutions. We are growing, and we still see significant potential in the Australian market.

We are looking for an Area Sales Manager based in Sydney who is motivated by developing new business, building strong customer relationships and creating spaces that bring people together through play and activity.

Drive sales growth across New South Wales

As Area Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales within your designated territory, working closely with the wider KOMPAN sales team.

You will:

  • Proactively generate new business and grow revenue and market share.

  • Identify, qualify and develop new sales opportunities.

  • Build strong relationships with local government, industry bodies, specialists and other key decision-makers.

  • Develop and execute a clear sales plan for your territory.

  • Manage your pipeline and sales activities through Dynamics 365 CRM.

  • Work with customers to develop play and fitness solutions that meet their needs.

This is a field‑based role where you’ll work from home, plan your own schedule, and spend most days on the road meeting customers and potential customers. You’ll have the autonomy to structure your week while being supported by a collaborative and high‑performing sales team.

A sales professional with a strong commercial mindset

You are commercially driven, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of your territory. You enjoy developing new relationships and have the persistence to take opportunities from first conversation through to a successful project.

Additionally, we are looking for:

  • 5+ years' of experience in specification, project or solution-based sales

  • B2B technical sales experience within construction, architecture, engineering or a related sector.

  • Strong connections with, or experience selling to, local government authorities.

  • A track record of developing new business and building a healthy sales pipeline.

  • Strong relationship-building, influencing and stakeholder management skills.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to join a growing business, take ownership of an important territory and develop further as KOMPAN continues to grow in Australia.

KOMPAN -  Who are we?

KOMPAN is a global leader in outdoor play and fitness solutions. We design, produce, and install over 1,000 playgrounds and fitness areas every month across 94 countries. Our HQ is based in Odense, Denmark, with a manufacturing site in Czech Republic and sales offices worldwide. Read more

What’s our culture like? 

We combine professionalism with playfulness. Our teams work across functions and cultures, valuing diversity, creativity, and results.

Why should you work with us? 

At KOMPAN, we make a real impact, creating healthier, happier communities through play and movement, and we have been doing so since 1970. You’ll have the opportunity to grow your career while making a difference worldwide. This is a very strong purpose to be part of.

How to apply? 

Please apply via our website. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and you can expect to hear from us once we have selected candidates to proceed to a first interview. You will, of course, hear from us regardless of whether you proceed in the process or not.

Here's a tip!

If you don’t see a current vacancy that matches your competencies and interests, we encourage you to connect with us. Once registered, your profile will automatically be matched with future openings and you’ll receive an invitation to apply when a good match is found. 

We regularly post new vacancies on our website. If you're interested in other opportunities with us, be sure to check back often. Let’s Play! 

KOMPAN is an equal opportunities employer and encourages everyone to apply.

item.title: Group IT Director
item.description:
We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented Group IT Director to shape KOMPAN’s global IT strategy, strengthen our international IT organisation and ensure that technology effectively supports our continued growth and strategic ambitions.

This is an opportunity to take end-to-end responsibility for Group IT, lead an international organisation of approximately 50 employees and act as a strategic technology partner to Group Management and the wider business.

Lead KOMPAN’s global IT strategy

As Group IT Director, you will define and execute our Group IT strategy, roadmap and operating model. You will ensure that applications, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity and technology capabilities support our business priorities while providing a stable and scalable foundation for future growth.

Working closely with Group Management, functional leaders and business process owners, you will translate business priorities into a focused portfolio of IT initiatives and ensure strong governance, prioritisation and execution.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Leading the Group IT strategy and technology roadmap and ensuring strong alignment with KOMPAN’s business priorities.

  • Leading and developing our international IT organisation and strengthening capabilities across applications, architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data and digital solutions.

  • Driving major technology and transformation programmes across ERP, PLM, CRM, digital platforms, BI and production systems.

  • Ensuring reliable and scalable global IT operations while continuously improving cybersecurity, automation, AI-enabled support and the overall user experience

  • Ensuring cost-efficient IT operations and continuous cost optimization, including reducing software licensing costs, through disciplined prioritization, robust business cases and value-driven IT investments.

Build a strong and scalable global IT organisation

A key part of the role will be to continuously develop a business-oriented and efficient global IT organisation that supports more than 2,400 employees across KOMPAN Group.

You will lead approximately 50 IT colleagues, primarily based at our headquarters in Denmark and our technology and delivery hub in Brno, Czech Republic, with additional IT 1. level support capabilities in the US.

You will strengthen competencies within strategically important technology areas while creating clear accountability and strong collaboration between IT and the business.

An experienced IT leader with strong business understanding

We are looking for an experienced IT leader who combines strategic thinking with strong execution. You understand how technology can enable growth, improve efficiency and strengthen business performance, and you are able to translate complex technology topics into clear business priorities.

Preferably, you have experience from an international organisation with a design, manufacturing and installation value chain. This will enable you to understand the complexity of KOMPAN’s business and how technology connects processes across product development, manufacturing, sales and installation.

You bring:

  • Significant senior IT leadership experience from an international organisation.

  • Experience defining and executing IT strategies and leading complex technology and transformation programmes.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise applications, infrastructure, architecture and cybersecurity.

  • Strong business understanding combined with experience managing significant IT budgets, external partners and senior stakeholders.

As a leader, you create direction and accountability while building collaboration across functions and geographies. You are pragmatic, decisive and execution-focused, with the ability to balance strategic transformation with operational stability. You are also curious about emerging technologies and how areas such as AI and automation can create tangible value for the business.

Group IT at KOMPAN

The Group IT organisation consists of approximately 50 employees across Denmark, the Czech Republic and the US, covering areas such as business applications, infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital platforms, ERP development, production IT and end-user support.

The position reports to the Group CFO and is based at KOMPAN’s Group headquarters in Odense, Denmark.

item.title: Area Sales Manager Eastern Europe
item.description:
Drive growth and build strong partnerships across Eastern Europe

Based in Poland, you will take ownership of a diverse international territory, working closely with distributors, partners, and key customers to strengthen our position and identify new opportunities for growth.

As our Area Sales Manager, you will have commercial responsibility for your territory and play a key role in expanding KOMPAN Restaurants across Eastern Europe. You will develop both existing and new business, strengthen our distributor and partner network, and build lasting relationships with key customers and strategic accounts.

With a high degree of autonomy, you will plan and prioritise your territory while collaborating closely with colleagues across European Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Finance and Supply Chain. Externally, you will work with distributors, channel partners, key accounts, end customers and other important decision-makers within the market.

Your primary responsibilities include:

  • Owning and developing sales performance across the Eastern European territory, with responsibility for achieving revenue, margin and annual sales targets.

  • Managing and growing existing distributor and partner relationships while identifying and developing new business opportunities.

  • Building strong relationships with key customers and strategic accounts and driving greater market penetration and brand visibility.

  • Managing the commercial process, including forecasting, pipeline management, pricing, contract negotiations and commercial agreements.

  • Gathering market and competitor insights, supporting product launches and participating in relevant trade fairs, exhibitions and customer events.

The position is based in Poland and requires significant travel across the region, expected to be more than 50% of the role. A company car is provided.

A commercially driven relationship builder with strong ownership

We are looking for someone who knows how to take ownership of a territory and turn opportunities into sustainable business. You are comfortable working independently across countries and cultures, but you also understand that strong collaboration internally is essential to delivering results.

You bring solid B2B sales experience from a territory-based, regional or key account role. Experience managing distributors, channel partners or strategic customers will be particularly valuable. Your background could come from industrial or technical manufacturing, construction and building solutions, engineering, B2B distribution or another project-driven commercial environment.

We imagine that you:

  • Have solid B2B sales experience, including experience owning and developing a geographic territory.

  • Have worked successfully with distributors, partners, key accounts or other complex B2B customer relationships.

  • Are confident in new business development, negotiation and commercial discussions.

  • Work in a structured and disciplined way with pipeline management, forecasting and CRM.

  • Are self-driven, resilient and results-oriented, with the confidence to work with a high level of autonomy.

You are fluent in Polish and have a good working level of English. Additional Eastern European languages, such as Hungarian, Bulgarian, Romanian, Czech or Croatian, would be an advantage.

A bachelor's degree within Business, Sales, Marketing or a related area is relevant, but equivalent commercial or technical sales experience is equally valued.

item.title: Head of Finance Business Partnering & Business Intelligence
item.description:
Are you ready to connect strategy, data and systems to create scalable growth and stronger business performance?

Lead financial decision support and business performance

As Head of Finance Business Partnering & Business Intelligence, you will strengthen financial decision support, performance management and business intelligence across the KOMPAN Group.

Based at our Group HQ, you will connect Group Finance, Management, HQ functions, local Finance teams and IT to support better decisions and scalable growth.

You will lead a team of four working across BI development and Finance Business Partnering, driving Group FP&A, analytics and strategic financial initiatives.

Other key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the Group FP&A agenda, including budgeting, forecasting, target setting and performance follow-up across Sales entities, HQ functions and Supply Chain.

  • Act as a trusted Finance partner to selected HQ functions and Group Management, providing insight, constructive challenge and recommendations that support performance and value creation.

  • Develop relevant financial and operational KPIs and ensure consistent, forward-looking management information.

  • Serve as Finance lead or partner on Group-wide initiatives within areas such as cost optimisation, productivity, investments and Net Working Capital.

  • Own and develop the Group Business Intelligence strategy and roadmap, lead the BI team and set clear priorities for reporting, analytics and AI-enabled decision support.

  • Drive simplification, standardisation and automation across reporting, analytics and selected Finance processes.

A strategic finance leader who turns insight into action

You combine strong financial leadership with a commercial and analytical mindset. You understand how strategy, financial performance, operational KPIs and business intelligence must connect, and you can translate complex information into clear priorities and actionable decision support. You build trust across functions while also providing the constructive challenge needed to improve performance.

We also imagine that you have:

  • Proven experience leading and developing a team of finance professionals.

  • Strong experience within Finance Business Partnering, FP&A, performance management or a comparable finance leadership role.

  • Proven ability to lead planning, forecasting and performance management in a complex organisation.

  • Experience developing management reporting, KPIs, business intelligence and analytics that support decision-making.

  • Ability to develop and challenge business cases, assumptions, financial impacts, risks and expected returns.

  • Experience collaborating effectively with senior leaders, Finance, IT and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • A structured improvement mindset with the ability to simplify, standardise and automate processes.

  • Clear communication skills and the ability to create ownership, transparency and accountability across the organisation.

item.title: Sales Manager, Caribbean Basin Region
item.description:
Do you thrive on developing markets, building strong partnerships, and creating long-term customer relationships? Are you motivated by working independently while being part of a global organization with a meaningful purpose?

As our new Sales Manager for the Caribbean Basin Region, you will play a key role in expanding KOMPAN's presence across Colombia, Venezuela, Central America, Yucatán Peninsula (Mexico), and the Caribbean Islands.

You will work closely with distributors, architects, developers, consultants, and key accounts to create healthier and happier communities through world-class play and fitness solutions.

Become the driving force behind KOMPAN's growth in the Caribbean Basin

As Sales Manager, you will be KOMPAN's representative in the region and take ownership of developing our market position and increasing awareness of our playground and fitness solutions among key stakeholders.

Working closely with our distributors and the LATAM & Caribbean team, you will help ensure that KOMPAN becomes the preferred choice for premium outdoor and indoor play and fitness solutions.

You will report directly to the General Manager LATAM & Caribbean.

Your primary responsibilities include:

  • Developing KOMPAN's market presence and securing strong regional coverage across the Caribbean Basin.

  • Creating and executing sales plans that support sustainable year-on-year growth.

  • Managing, training, motivating, and supporting distributors and their sales teams.

  • Generating new business opportunities and establishing relationships with architects, developers, consultants, contractors, and key accounts.

  • Identifying and qualifying new business opportunities and strategic customer segments.

  • Visiting customers and project sites to generate awareness and uncover upcoming opportunities.

  • Coordinating seminars, webinars, and customer education activities across the region.

  • Supporting tender processes and ensuring strong project specifications together with distributors.

  • Following up on leads, project opportunities, and account receivables.

  • Collaborating with marketing and business stakeholders to strengthen KOMPAN's market position

  • Supporting the collection process by following up on outstanding payments and working closely with distributors and customers to ensure timely payment and healthy account receivable levels.

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and flexibility, combined with extensive regional travel. You will spend much of your time engaging directly with customers, partners, and influencers throughout the region, helping create inspiring projects that positively impact communities. Travel will primarily take place across the Caribbean Basin, with occasional visits to Chile, Mexico, Europe, and the United States.

A commercially driven Sales Manager with strong relationship-building skills

You are an experienced sales professional who enjoys developing markets, building networks, navigating complex sales cycles and has experience with high-value products.

You are comfortable working independently and know how to create momentum through distributors, partners, and key stakeholders.

Your experience may come from the playground industry, construction, architecture, engineering, or another project-based sales environment. Most importantly, you have a proven ability to drive business growth and develop strong customer relationships.

We imagine that you:

  • Have at least five years of experience from a similar sales or business development role.

  • Have experience working with distributors and indirect sales channels.

  • Have a successful track record of managing and closing complex sales projects involving high-value solutions.

  • Understand specification-driven sales processes within public and private projects.

  • Possess strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Are fluent in both Spanish and English, verbally and in writing.

  • Are comfortable using Microsoft Office and preferably have experience with CRM systems.

As a person, you are:

  • Self-driven, proactive, and highly motivated.

  • Positive and professional in your approach.

  • Organized and structured, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Hands-on and solution-oriented.

  • Skilled at navigating challenges and resolving conflicts constructively

KOMPAN LATAM & Caribbean

You will become part of KOMPAN's LATAM & Caribbean organization and work closely with colleagues, distributors, and partners across multiple countries and cultures. We are passionate about creating healthier and happier communities and share a strong commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences and business results.

Although much of your work will be carried out independently in the region, you will be supported by an international network of experienced colleagues across sales, marketing, design, and project execution.
